name: Web Intelligence 9-Angle Skill Pack
purpose: Convert current web-source intelligence into operational skills for Player 2, n8n, shell ops, proof, and deployment.

source_strategy.proof_rule: Every extracted skill must link to a source, a target operation, a safe mode, a test, and an evidence artifact.

nine_angles.source_pattern: Model Context Protocol for connecting agents to tools, APIs, resources, files, databases, and workflows.
nine_angles.operation_use: Expose approved local tools and data to agents through typed tool/resource contracts.

nine_angles.source_pattern: Agent2Agent for communication and delegation between agents built with different frameworks.
nine_angles.operation_use: Generate Agent Cards for Player 2, Codex Builder, Claude Auditor, n8n Courier, and Proof Sentinel.

nine_angles.source_pattern: Agents SDK style loop: agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, human-in-the-loop, sandbox workspaces.
nine_angles.operation_use: Run multi-step work where the runtime tracks tool calls, handoffs, memory, and trace output.

nine_angles.source_pattern: n8n workflows, nodes, triggers, credentials, execution logs, source control, and data transformation.
nine_angles.operation_use: Turn approved data lanes into repeatable workflow plans with human review gates before external writes.

nine_angles.source_pattern: LangGraph/CrewAI-style durable, stateful, long-running orchestration and agent teams.
nine_angles.operation_use: Define long-running processes with persistence, human review, checkpoints, and agent crews.

nine_angles.source_pattern: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, logs, baggage, and profiles as proof signals.
nine_angles.operation_use: Map every shell/agent/n8n/GitHub run into trace, metric, and log records.

nine_angles.source_pattern: GitHub artifact attestations and SLSA-style provenance for source-to-artifact trust.
nine_angles.operation_use: Attach provenance to generated packages, scripts, and deployment outputs.

nine_angles.source_pattern: OWASP GenAI risks: prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, supply chain, excessive agency, output handling, unbounded consumption.
nine_angles.operation_use: Block unsafe prompt-to-shell and prompt-to-agent paths before execution.

nine_angles.source_pattern: Data banking loop: source proof, normalized memory, task outcomes, skill performance, and reusable knowledge assets.
nine_angles.operation_use: Score skills by reuse, successful runs, risk avoided, time saved, money/opportunity impact, and proof quality.

compound_formula: compound_leverage = (source_quality * extraction_rate * reusable_skill_count * proof_quality * deployment_velocity) - (risk_drag + context_switch_cost + failed_run_penalty)
